# ImageOptions

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Options for [`Image`](image.md).

`filePath` and `imageData` are mutually exclusive sources; supply one. `filePath` is Node-only; `imageData` is universal.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
type ImageOptions = ElementOptions & Partial<Omit<Pick<Image, (typeof IMAGE_OWN_OPTION_KEYS)[number]>, 'fitMode' | 'width' | 'height'>> & {
    /** Width. Accepts a length: a number of points, `'1cm'`, or `{ value, unit }`. */
    width?: LengthInput;
    /** Height. Accepts a length: a number of points, `'2cm'`, or `{ value, unit }`. */
    height?: LengthInput;
    /** How the image fills its box. Accepts `'contain' | 'cover' | 'fill' | 'fit-height' | 'actual-size'`. */
    fitMode?: ImageFitModeInput;
}
```

### `altText`

```typescript
altText?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

Alternate text description for accessibility. When the document opts into `AccessibilityMode.PdfUa1`, this populates the `/Alt` entry on the structure element wrapping the image. Required by PDF/UA for non-decorative figures.

### `breakAllowed`

```typescript
breakAllowed?: boolean | undefined
```

*optional*

Whether this element can be split across page boundaries. When false, the element is treated as atomic and will be moved to a new page rather than split. If it doesn't fit on a fresh page either, it renders anyway. Default is true.

### `captureName`

```typescript
captureName?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

Optional author-supplied name/key surfaced in the layout snapshot. Unset by default; a future capture API can populate it.

### `contentDirection`

```typescript
contentDirection?: ContentDirectionInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Inline progression and paragraph base direction; omitted inherits.

### `filePath`

```typescript
filePath?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

Path to image file (mutually exclusive with imageData)

### `fitMode`

```typescript
fitMode?: ImageFitModeInput | undefined
```

*optional*

How the image fills its box. Accepts `'contain' | 'cover' | 'fill' | 'fit-height' | 'actual-size'`.

### `height`

```typescript
height?: LengthInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Height. Accepts a length: a number of points, `'2cm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

### `imageData`

```typescript
imageData?: Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike> | undefined
```

*optional*

Raw image data (mutually exclusive with filePath)

### `isDecorative`

```typescript
isDecorative?: boolean | undefined
```

*optional*

When `true`, the image is purely decorative and is tagged as `/Artifact` with no alt-text warning. Set explicitly for decorative borders, dividers, and background imagery.

### `keepResolution`

```typescript
keepResolution?: boolean | undefined
```

*optional*

When `true`, the image is embedded at its source resolution regardless of the document's `maxImageDpi`. If the same image is placed more than once, one placement with this set keeps the whole embedded copy at full resolution.

### `keepWithNext`

```typescript
keepWithNext?: boolean | undefined
```

*optional*

Keeps this element with the start of its next sibling in vertical flow.

### `maintainAspectRatio`

```typescript
maintainAspectRatio?: boolean | undefined
```

*optional*

Whether to maintain aspect ratio (ignored for Fill mode)

### `margin`

```typescript
margin?: ThicknessInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Margin around this element. Accepts `12`, `[h, v]`, `[l, t, r, b]` or `{ bottom: 12 }`; omitted sides are zero.

### `width`

```typescript
width?: LengthInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Width. Accepts a length: a number of points, `'1cm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.
